messages:
Priya M: Heads-up: Clearwave (dedicated pool dp-clear-07) reporting p99 token-serving latency spike since 03:40 UTC after last canary rollout. Customer is seeing p99 ~2.1s vs baseline ~120ms and intermittent 503s. This is an SLA risk — need short-term mitigation and clear owners. Minimal logs below.

Priya M: ```
[03:41:02] serve: request_id=aa12 p99=2100ms status=200 model=clarion-v2-q4_8
[03:41:08] serve: request_id=aa47 p99=2200ms status=503 reason=kv-cache-miss
[03:42:10] serve: request_id=ab03 p99=2050ms status=200 model=clarion-v2-q4_8
```

Alex S: tagging @Sam R and @Jordan T — can runtime confirm whether the quantized execution path rolled with canary?

Sam R: Confirmed — canary pushed clarion-v2-q4_8 -> runtime used new fused-kernel path for matmul. I see increases on tails for seq>512. Reproducing locally with same model + long prompts.

Mei L: We also enabled a memory-saving cache policy in the canary to reduce footprint. Could be causing extra KV cache churn for long context.

Jordan T: Eng-SRE: I can scale dp-clear-07 by +2 nodes immediately to buy time, but that's a blunt instrument. If runtime can flip fallback to clarion-v2-q4_4 variant per-customer, that would be ideal.

Sam R: I can flip a routing override but need the exact routing key. Priya — do we have the customer routing tag?

Priya M: Clearwave routing tag is customer:clearwave. If we do rollout rollback or variant fallback, we need to notify CS and ops. Carlos (CS) can confirm communication.

Carlos (CS): Confirmed. If we trigger fallback to clarion-v2-q4_4, we should message Clearwave within 10min and set expectation of degraded model perf (but stable latency). They prioritize latency over slight quality delta.

Alex S: Proposed short-term plan: 1) Jordan scales pool +2 nodes (immediate). 2) Sam flips per-customer routing override to clarion-v2-q4_4 (if tests pass) and sets TTL 1h. 3) Mei reverts cache policy for dp-clear-07. 4) Priya notifies CS for customer comms. Who owns each?

Jordan T: I own scaling — will do now and post update.

Sam R: I own the routing override. Will test on staging then hit prod toggle. ETA 12 minutes after tests.

Mei L: I'll revert the cache policy for that pool; doing change with small rollout to avoid ripple. ETA 8 minutes.

Priya M: Carlos will send the first customer note. Also we need a postmortem after stabilization: cause analysis + whether kernel change needs a canary guard for long-context profiles.

Carlos (CS): On it. Drafting note to Clearwave now, will ping legal if they want different wording.

deploy-bot: deploy canary clarion-v2-q4_8 -> dp-clear-07 detected at 03:39:54 UTC by @eng-runtime (SHA: b3f9ab).

Alex S: Quick checklist for Sam before flip: - confirm model variant clarion-v2-q4_4 is present in pool - confirm compatibility with existing KV cache layout - prepare rollback toggle.

Sam R: All checked on staging. There's a minor kv-layout version skew but runtime supports a compatibility shim; I will enable override in config: ```
route_overrides:
  customer:clearwave: clarion-v2-q4_4
ttl: 3600s
```

Mei L: Cache policy revert started on dp-clear-07 (small percentage). Observing metrics...

Jordan T: Scaling +2 nodes done, pods rebalanced. Observability shows immediate P95 improvement; p99 still high but trending down.

Sam R: Tests passed, applying override in 2m.

Sam R: Override applied. Monitoring.

Priya M: Please post p95/p99 and error rate in 10 minutes. If metrics good, we'll keep override and schedule a controlled canary rollback for clarion-v2-q4_8 with long-context traffic gating.

Jordan T: 10m check: p95 back to 140ms, p99 250ms, 503s dropped to near zero. Looks stable.

Carlos (CS): Customer notified: "We rolled a protective fallback to an immediately-stable variant while we investigate upstream cause. Expect normal latency shortly; we will follow up with root cause and timeline." They replied :thumbsup: and asked for a weekly update.

Priya M: Thanks everyone. Owners: Sam=routing override + rollback toggle; Mei=cache policy revert + canary config; Jordan=scaling + infra ops; Alex=follow on PR for canary gating; Carlos=customer comms. Action items: 1) Sam to open PR for per-model kv-compat checks (ETA today). 2) Mei/Alex to draft canary gating criteria (latency thresholds for seq>512). 3) Postmortem in 48h.

Alex S: I'll open the gating doc and ping eng-ml and eng-runtime for signoff.

Sam R: Opening PR now -> https://git.company/repo/pulls/1427

Mei L: Noted. I'll add metrics and repro steps to the postmortem.

Priya M: Closing loop: leave this thread for follow-ups and link to postmortem when ready. Great coordination — :raised_hands:
